3.2.value: Current tender offer (SC TO-I filed 5/12/2026): Commencement Date May 12, 2026; Notice Date, Tender Withdrawal Date AND Valuation Date all June 16, 2026 (single-date design; all deadlines 4:00 p.m. ET). Pricing: each tendered Share purchased at NAV per Share calculated as of the Valuation Date; offer size up to 5% of outstanding shares calculated as of the Valuation Date. Settlement: payment 'as soon as possible following the determination of the NAV for the Valuation Date'; in no case later than eight (8) days after the last day Shares may be tendered. Withdrawal rights: revocable until 4:00 p.m. ET on the Tender Withdrawal Date; plus Rule 13e-4(f)(2) right to withdraw if tender not yet accepted 40 business days after Commencement Date; withdrawn Shares may be re-tendered before the Notice Date. Oversubscription/proration: if tenders exceed 5%, Fund may (a) accept additional Shares per Rule 13e-4(f)(3), (b) extend the offer and increase the amount, or (c) accept 'on a pro rata basis based on the aggregate net asset value of the tendered Shares'. Fund may cancel, amend or postpone before 4:00 p.m. ET on the Tender Withdrawal Date; extension moves pricing to the extended Notice Date. Funding sources: cash on hand, sales of portfolio securities, withdrawals of capital from investments, or borrowings; Fund segregates assets with custodian equal to the estimated payment. Tendered shares are retired; a tendering shareholder remains a shareholder through the Valuation Date. Compulsory repurchase reserved if an account falls below the Prospectus minimum. Cadence per N-CSR Note 10: quarterly offers typically occurring March 15, June 15, September 15, December 15, up to 5.00% of outstanding Shares per quarter, subject to Board discretion; Fund has no obligation to repurchase at any time.

6.2.value: Strategy sleeves: (1) Secondary Investments - secondary purchases of existing interests in operating companies/projects/properties and unaffiliated Investment Funds, incl. Open-Ended Funds, 'Seasoned Investments' (funds already ~25% invested at closing) and stapled secondaries; (2) Co-Investments - direct equity in operating companies alongside lead Investment Managers (Fund holds minority/non-controlling positions); (3) Primary Investments - funds <25% invested. Allocation target as printed: 80% policy - invest and/or commit at least 80% of assets (net assets plus borrowings for investment purposes) in Private Market Assets, with money market funds/cash/Treasuries <=1yr covering unfunded commitments counted as qualifying; 60 days' notice to change. No explicit numeric sleeve ranges printed. Instruments: may include below-investment-grade ('junk') securities; N-CSR shows Level 3 CLO and CLO Warehouse co-investments and public securities. FX: 'The Advisers will not elect to hedge the value of investments made by the Fund against currency fluctuations.'
6.2.section: Prospectus Summary / Investment Program (Q&A: The Fund's investment strategy is focused on three types)
6.2.quote: The Fund intends to invest and/or make capital commitments of at least 80% of its assets in Private Market Assets

6.3.value: Conflicts disclosures (prospectus 'Conflicts of Interest' section): Advisers manage substantial Other Accounts with differing economic interests and time-allocation conflicts; Other Accounts may take larger stakes or invest where Fund does not. Allocation policy: primaries deferred to Investment Manager; secondaries allocated by StepStone pro rata based on each client's annual portfolio-plan budget; Co-Investment allocation is a hybrid. Co-investment exemptive order: Advisers and Fund obtained SEC exemptive order permitting co-investment alongside affiliates in Private Market Assets, subject to conditions (incl. capacity constraints); plus Multi-Class Exemptive Relief. Affiliated-transaction dollar amounts (N-CSR Note 5, FY2026): Adviser earned $73.2 million Management Fees ($6.9M payable at 3/31/2026); Adviser as Administrator earned $3.4 million Administration Fees ($0.3M payable); Adviser pays Sub-Adviser 50% of the Management Fee.
6.3.section: Conflicts of Interest; Prospectus Summary (co-investment exemptive order)
6.3.quote: The Advisers and the Fund have obtained an exemptive order from the SEC that permits the Fund to co-invest alongside its affiliates in Private Market Assets

6.4.value: 1099 reporting, marketed as a feature: prospectus lists 'Form 1099 DIV or Form 1099-B tax reporting instead of K-1s' under Favorable Structure - the direct contrast to K-PEC's K-1s. The complexity factor's cleanest cross-product pair.
6.4.quote: Form 1099 DIV or Form 1099-B tax reporting instead of K-1s
